notes.text: Marcus Foligno is on injured reserve and has missed the last 12 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.

Jared Spurgeon is out week to week (lower body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. Jonas Brodin has taken his spot beside Quinn Hughes. That pair has had 40% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 39:21 together, down from 69% with Spurgeon.

Brock Faber is on injured reserve (skull surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Jonas Brodin has taken his spot beside Quinn Hughes. That pair has had 62% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 144:47 together.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 30% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 7th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 39%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.

Rasmus Ristolainen is on injured reserve and has missed the last 3 games. Jamie Drysdale has taken his spot beside Travis Sanheim. That pair has had 65% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 39:02 together, up from 23% with Ristolainen.
Nikita Grebenkin is out at least four months (back surgery) and has not played this season. Sean Couturier has taken his spot beside Owen Tippett and Trevor Zegras.
Owen Tippett returned in their last game after missing 6 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Travis Konecny returned in their last game after missing 10 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Cole Knuble was added to the roster on Oct 20 and has played beside Christian Dvorak and Trevor Zegras.
David Jiříček has started playing on the power play: on the ice for 43% of the team’s power-play time in 9 games, up from 2% last season.

stakes: The Wild go in first in the Central with 23 points, the Flyers tied for sixth in the Metropolitan with 12 points.

PHI.head: A tough matchup for the Flyers
PHI.body: Even though Philadelphia has home-ice advantage, Minnesota has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Flyers’ best way through is a power play that gets going.

MIN.head: The Wild should have the upper hand

story.head: Brink returns to Philadelphia
paras: The Wild (10-3-3) beat Washington 5-1 on Sunday, and the Flyers (4-8-4) beat Utah 6-3 the same night. Going in, the Wild are first in the Central (tied for third in the NHL) and the Flyers seventh in the Metropolitan (tied for 26th).

The Wild leave the shooting to their forwards (3rd lowest) and draw more penalties than they take (3rd), but get pinned in their own end on long shifts (31st). Minnesota has allowed 2.25 goals a game, the third fewest in the league. The Flyers play slow, tight games (2nd lowest) and pick their shots (3rd lowest). They also get a lot of their shots blocked (30th), so the Wild are likely to get in the way of a lot of their shots. Philadelphia has scored 2.19 goals a game, the fewest in the league. The Wild are likely to get plenty of pucks to the net against the Flyers.

Kirill Kaprizov (15 G / 10 A / 25 P in 16 GP) leads the Wild in scoring and is tied for fourth in the NHL, with eight points in his last five games. Quinn Hughes (5 G / 16 A / 21 P in 16 GP) isn’t far behind, with eight points in his last five games. For the Flyers, Trevor Zegras (4 G / 9 A / 13 P in 16 GP) leads the way in scoring, and Matvei Michkov (10 G / 2 A / 12 P in 16 GP) has a team-high ten goals, tied for sixth in the NHL.
Jesper Wallstedt (9-2-3 / .919 SV% in 14 GS) has been a rock in net for Minnesota and is expected to start. Dan Vladař (3-3-2 / .885 SV% in 8 GS) is expected to go for Philadelphia.

At home, Rick Tocchet likes to send Zegras, Dvorak and Konecny out against the other team’s top line, so watch for them against Kaprizov, Ek and Boldy. Elsewhere, the Wild usually control more of the chances than the Flyers do.

items.text: Bobby Brink faces Philadelphia for the first time since leaving.

The Wild are newly without Jared Spurgeon, have been without Marcus Foligno since Oct 8, and have had to make do without Filip Gustavsson and Brock Faber all season. Jesper Wallstedt is expected to start.
The Flyers are newly without Rasmus Ristolainen, and have had to make do without Nikita Grebenkin all season.
Sean Couturier has four goals in six games against Minnesota since 2023-24.
